en.headline: Authorities step up traffic management at Huanggang Port after weekend gridlock
en.dek: Police will open buffer zones and strengthen controls near the revamped crossing ahead of expected Halloween and concert peaks.
body: Hong Kong authorities have announced plans to strengthen traffic management at the revamped Huanggang Port after last weekend’s congestion caused by Halloween celebrations and concerts at Kai Tak Stadium.

A government spokesman said on Monday night that police would further enhance road traffic control and management near the crossing. Depending on traffic flow, they will implement contingency plans and open vehicle buffer zones as needed to channel cross-boundary buses, private cars and taxis more effectively.

The measures aim to speed up the movement of vehicles. Authorities had earlier kept a cross-department command centre operating and opened extra lanes and counters during peak periods. The government said it would continue to coordinate with public transport operators and monitor flows closely with Shenzhen counterparts.

zh.headline: 當局加強皇崗口岸交通管理 應對周末擠塞
zh.dek: 警方將視車流開設緩衝區並加強管制，以應對萬聖節及演唱會預期人流車流高峰。
body: 香港當局宣布加強翻新後皇崗口岸的交通管理，以防止上周末因萬聖節慶祝活動及啟德體育園演唱會引發的擠塞重演。
政府發言人周一晚表示，警方會進一步加強口岸附近的道路交通管制及管理。視乎車流情況，將實施應變計劃並按需要開設車輛緩衝區，更有效分流跨境巴士、私家車及的士。
有關措施旨在加快各類車輛的流動。當局早前已維持跨部門指揮中心運作，並在高峰期加開車道及櫃位。政府表示會繼續與公共交通營辦商協調，並與深圳方面密切監察客流車流。
